Params: {1: 'When a person dies, they only appear to have died.', 2: 'ffffffff', 7: '-3', 10: '1'}
{1: 'They go on living in the past, full of life... so it is quite foolish to grieve at their funeral.', 2: 'ffffffff', 7: '-1', 10: '1'}
{1: 'All moments... past, present, and future, have always existed...', 2: 'ffffffff', 7: '-1', 10: '1'}
{2: 'Aufbruch, Zero-point City 01, Deep Underground. Not Long Ago.'}
{3: 'An explosion erupts in his M.I.N.D. Vital fluid surges through the body as his body spasms.'}
{3: 'Gunfire rains down beneath a burning sky, as if a fragment of memory, cut away and long forgotten, is flooding back all at once.'}
{3: 'The ringing and the pain bore deep into his spine, and the agent who should be dead is granted a brief moment once more.'}
{3: 'Words come before thought, slipping out unbidden.'}
{3: 'He slowly rises to his feet. The wound left by the pyro katana is torn open further.'}
{3: 'He staggers forward, each step driven by an unshakeable sense of direction.'}
{3: 'His M.I.N.D. is a storm of noise, yet the pain at his core keeps reminding him that there is still something left to be done.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Trout', 3: 'You burst into this world back then because Zero-point Reactor 1 fired up, which is also what set off the Punishing outbreak.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Trout', 3: 'So, perhaps the Tower can come down here again the moment Zero-point Reactor 1 restarts.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'He falters, and vital fluid pours from his wound, staining the ground red.'}
{3: 'When playing out outcomes in his mind, he rarely uses the word "perhaps."'}
{3: 'The origin of the Punishing Virus and the arrival of the Hetero Tower... Was his conclusion too rash?'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Trout', 3: '...Was it Dominik, or was it the contaminating memetic?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'What was that vision and that noise in his M.I.N.D. that led him here?'}
{3: 'He staggers on, stumbling through the region with the highest concentration of Punishing Virus on Earth.'}
{3: 'Even without a single ray of light, he knows exactly which way to go.'}
{3: 'The remains of Corrupted litter the ground, and the door to the reactor stands half-open—someone forced their way in from the outside.'}
{3: 'His borrowed time runs out at last. Another piece of viscera slips out from the wound, and he has no choice but to lean against the door to drag himself through.'}
{3: 'A strange light rushes to meet him, and all colors in his vision rapidly drain.'}
{3: 'The reactor that should dominate the space blurs and fades into the background. The entire space folds and shifts, giving way to a gleam of golden light.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The path to the great tree is strewn with the dead.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Countless masks lie shattered across the ground, and every face among the dead is identical.'}
{3: 'Countless versions of <phonetic=Trout>himself</phonetic>, each dead in a different way.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'At the far end of the mountain of bodies, a figure slowly turns and looks at him.'}
{2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'You've found the future that was "destined to happen."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'But as you can see, there is nothing here.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'Fortunately, [Atheism] severed the closed loop of fate, and so you became the last of us.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Alpha', 3: 'Too many people deserve your apologies and amends. Your regrets just keep piling up.', 4: '18'}
{3: 'The memories that were cut away begin flooding back.'}
{2: 'Trout', 3: 'Nemo... you knew all of this from the very beginning.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Trout', 3: 'You said I was the "last"... Does that mean I've become part of the noise as well?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'Every path has its purpose. Only through my silence would you commit to your plan to intervene in time, and come to understanding on your own.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'In almost every possibility, this place is where we end. Yet somewhere among the dead, someone carved out the one exception.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'He raises a hand. Golden light spills forth, and a cascade of fragmented data weaves itself into color, bleeding across his vision.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'I hope those two can prove themselves right, so I can finally be freed from this endless cycle.', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Chaos', 3: 'You won't find freedom... I need you to help me stay conscious a while longer.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'You're exhausted. Mission and hope pile onto you repeatedly, and so you keep spending the one thing you were truly free to spend.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'Running yourself ragged, you never once stopped or took a moment to ask yourself what your objective is.', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Trout', 3: 'Homecoming. Redemption. Coexistence. There are plenty of words for it.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'Simply put, you want to preserve at least one human civilization when the inevitable disaster comes.', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Trout', 3: 'Which one exactly? I don't particularly care.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vonnegut', 3: '...After all this torment, maybe it's time to admit that someone did it better than us.', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: 'He moves aside, revealing the golden tangle of threads behind him.'}
{3: 'Curled within the flowing light is a familiar figure.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'Before the Hetero Tower was destroyed, my M.I.N.D. absorbed the data from the lower layers of Chaos.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'Perhaps our bodies had long since adapted to that kind of turmoil, so when everything collapsed, I survived against all odds and found my way here.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'He turns to look at the towering tree behind him.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'This is where all consciousness originates, and where all civilizations come to be buried. Dominik and Arius gave it a fitting name: the Phylotree.', 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Trout', 3: 'I know... Project Cthylla was modeled after it, and to see it through, my "key" drew from its power as well.', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Trout', 3: '...If Chaos was still in the Tower, then what is that behind you?', 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'It's the part of Chaos most deeply connected to 【kuroname】. I pulled it from the Red Tide at the bottom of the Atlantic.', 4: '18'}
{2: '???', 3: 'Memories... I'm giving them back to you.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'I can confirm that her mind is stacking and inheriting across countless layers, just like the Hetero Tower.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'I need her to be reborn from the true Phylotree and claim its full authority.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'He raises his fingers, and countless threads of the Phylotree surge from the earth, piling into the sky with a thunderous roar.'}
{3: 'Countless extinguished universes fill the sky like a vast grid. All possibilities severed by [Atheism] are frozen together in a single moment.'}
{3: 'A Dark Star hangs over the collapsing universes, ever-present.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Trout', 3: '...Since the Hetero Tower's disappearance, most of what had already happened has happened again, save for what 【kuroname】 fought to prevent.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'On the verge of his collapse, he grasps the weight of his other self's fears in an instant.'}
{2: 'Trout', 3: 'But even now, there is one last variable that has yet to appear.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'His other self gives him a nod.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The ashen world falls silent, and all those inevitable defeats flash before his eyes once more.'}
{3: 'He walks forward wearily, climbing to the summit of corpses one step at a time.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'But the ordeal ahead is still long. I should remind you, Trout, that you still have the right to walk away.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Trout', 3: 'If the outcome is inevitable either way, what difference does the journey make?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Trout', 3: 'This is the life I have left...', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: 'A faint, bitter smile appears on his face as he reaches up and removes his own mask.'}
{2: 'Trout', 3: 'No matter how this begins or ends, our choice remains the same.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Then, with his own hands, he covers his face.'}
{1: 'Divergent paths converge, and all the information from every remaining world floods into Vonnegut at once, instantly emptying the power of the Ascension-Network.', 5: '3'}
{1: 'Through a shared, higher-dimensional authority, the Phylotree, sensing the approach of crisis, chooses its agent at this very moment.'}
{1: 'Infinite knowledge and vision unfurl in an instant.', 7: '1'}
{3: 'Gazing down aeons of civilization, he finally grasps the link between everything.'}
{2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'The quantum vacuum is the Punishing Virus' breeding ground. Long before its arrival, the contaminating memetic had already come to Earth as its "vanguard."', 4: '2'}
{3: 'He drops the conclusion abruptly, as though he intends for someone to hear it.'}
{2: 'Vonnegut', 3: 'Did you prepare all of this for me?', 4: '2'}
{3: 'He turns around and finds someone familiar.'}
